mentions.name: Google Form UI customizer
mentions.description: A web product for customizing the UI of Google Forms, letting users adjust form appearance. Built with Next.js, Drizzle ORM, PostgreSQL, shadcn, and Tailwind, and hosted on a DigitalOcean VPS using Traefik.
